Meta’s FY2024 operating margin is calculated as income from operations divided by revenue for fiscal year 2024. The FY2024 10-K shows:

- Fiscal year 2024 revenue: $164,501 million [DOC: meta_10k_fy2024.txt]  
- Fiscal year 2024 income from operations: $69,380 million [DOC: meta_10k_fy2024.txt]  

Both figures are for the same fiscal year and on the same basis, so they are directly comparable.

Operating margin = 69,380 / 164,501 ≈ 42.18% [DOC: meta_10k_fy2024.txt]

ANSWER: Approximately 42.2%
